implementation.change: Generate a speculative direct streaming decoder for proven pure schemas, with full-input validation and the historical text decoder as fallback.
implementation.ownership: Owned strings and independently allocated containers. Repeated key reads along one program path reject streaming to preserve independent decoded containers. No arena or pool.
implementation.compatibility: Separate optional streamDecoderABI1; existing text/index ABI and typedKind layout preserved.
implementation.scope: No benchmark, corpus, oracle, reference C/JS or timing harness change for the JSON gain.
